executiveSummary: The week’s work covered account access, investigation of the outstanding Local Services Ads approval and a client-agreed hold on September 7. Further priorities will be set after the client’s planned review. LSA approval and live serving have not been established, and the prepared organic package remains awaiting a publication decision.
